diagnosis_candidates.description: The file `application-dev.yml` is named for the `dev` profile, but its internal `spring.config.activate.on-profile` property is set to `staging`. Because the active profile is `dev`, the properties in this file (including the development shipping endpoint) are not loaded, causing the application to fall back to the default endpoint defined in `application.yml`.
diagnosis_candidates.recommended_fix: Change the `spring.config.activate.on-profile` value in `application-dev.yml` to `dev`, or rename the file to `application-staging.yml` if the intention was to configure the staging profile.
diagnosis_candidates.title: Mismatched profile activation condition in application-dev.yml

diagnosis_evidence.summary: The development endpoint is not selected because `application-dev.yml` contains a profile activation condition for `staging` instead of `dev`. When the `dev` profile is active, this file's properties are ignored, causing a fallback to the default endpoint.
